caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a rectangular top and rounded corners. The table is a medium to dark brown color, with subtle shading suggesting a polished wood grain surface. The table has a single horizontal drawer in the center, which features a decorative circular brass-colored handle. Supporting the tabletop is a carved, ornate pedestal that tapers downward and is divided into four curved legs. Each leg extends outward and ends with a brass claw foot that appears to hold a small brass ball. The table is centrally positioned within a double-lined rectangular border that frames the image on a plain, off-white background with slight yellowing around the edges. There are no additional objects or decorations in the drawing.
title: Table
